name: Sausage, Cauliflower & Pepper Bowl with Cilantro-Jalapeño Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow potatoes
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheets with the potato.
Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; add to the baking sheets.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Add sausages to the baking sheets, nestling them into the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Place in a blender. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the blender with the jalapeño (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Add mayo, water, salt, and pepper to the blender; purée on high until the sauce is smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide veggies and sausage between bowls; pour sauce over top and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
